turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brings you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hi uh so I just came in today uh I've kind of put it off for a bit, but I've been having this cough uh for the last five to six months and it seems to be getting worse and over the last month I've also been becoming more short of breath, so I just wanted to come and check if I need to do anything.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, that that it's it's really good that you decided to come in. Um how bad is your shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so usually like I I would be able to walk a few blocks, um no problem, but now I have to take a break and catch my breath and even going up and down stairs has been tough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um Do you feel that uh do you feel that your, uh, difficulty with breathing is worse when you're exerting yourself?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, it's definitely worse, but I also just like normally even when I'm resting, I feel like I have to um take in like much deeper breaths.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you ever wake up in the middle of the night gasping for air?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you feel like you have to raise your head or have multiple pillows to sleep at night so you don't feel short of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm and this cough that you've had for the past five or six months, did you say it's getting worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah it it's, both the shortness of breath and the cough are getting worse and also just I've been having some even some discomfort and pain when taking those deep breaths now too. So, and that's been happening for probably the last couple weeks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. Um is it a dry cough that you have or or do you bring up any gunk or any mucus?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um it's mainly just a like a like a dry cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you ever coughed up any blood or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't, I don't think I've seen any blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm do you have any other symptoms? Do you have any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um not fevers, but I I have been getting night sweats um for the last couple weeks to maybe even a month or once or twice a week, I just wake up completely drenched.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you had any unintentional weight loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, now that you mention it, I probably lost 15 pounds in the last two months.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, have you had any muscle aches or joint pains all over your body? Do you feel achy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, but I've probably felt like that for the last five years, um so I have uh osteoarthritis.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I don't think that's anything new.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um have you had any changes in your bowel movements or any urinary symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uhm, OK. Uh have you had any falls in the past or in the past couple of months or years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I've been lucky.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Good. Any confusion?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh any time when you've lost consciousness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not that I know of, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Um and any medical conditions that you've been diagnosed with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so I have osteoarthritis. And then I also have um this condition with my prostate, uh BPH. And um I also take medications for my blood pressure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um what medications do you take?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I take um this medication called uh Lisinopril.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Anything else?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I do take uh just pain medications like Advil.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um OK. Do you take anything to protect your stomach when you're taking the Advil, any other medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I was given um this other medication for, for, to take with my Advil like, but it's only when I'm taking Advil like every day. Um and, um I haven't really been taking that, um I probably took, the last time I took it was probably a month ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, OK. That's good. Um are you taking anything for your uh BPH?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, sorry. So I'm taking uh this medication called Tamsulosin.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright, any allergies, to medications or otherwise?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh mot that I know of, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any um I guess social history, who do you currently live with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I live alone right now in my apartment I, um but I have pretty good support from my kids, they just live a few blocks away and come visit me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: That's good. That's really good. And uh do you, are you able to um take care of yourself or do you need help with things like um finances and groceries and cleaning?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I'm I'm fairly independent in those matters.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you require any assistance uh with walking any cane or walker or wheelchair, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not yet.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK good good. Do you smoke at all or did you ever smoke in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've been smoking for my whole life.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How long and how much and for how many years?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um probably for almost, I guess 50 years or maybe even more, maybe like 55 years and uh I've been smoking, at one point I even smoked up to like two two packs a day, but now, like for the last, at least 20, 30 years, it's been like one pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you ever been diagnosed with any lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you um had any marijuana or any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, alright, um you mentioned that the cough started 5 to six months ago. Have you had a cough before that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's here and there, like maybe just when I wake up sometimes, but this is kind of uh more frequent and, I I do feel just kind of this discomfort in my chest when I take these deep breaths as well. Um yeah so, I I don't really know what's going on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um do you go to your family doctor for your uh health checkups?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I haven't been for a while, for the last few months, but yeah, I generally do go to my family doctor.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You do, OK. Um have you been, uh, sometimes for people who have been smoking for a long time, they do uh these scans of the lungs, uhm, have you been getting those?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't remember the last time I had one.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK Alright. Um OK, those are all the questions I had for you. Uhm, we'll we'll do a physical exam and uh do your vitals um and see if you uh, do some labs, and then go from there.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sounds good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome.
